<br><br>


::: {#hero-heading}

I'm a researcher exploring the intersection of **language, technology, and ethics**. My work centers on automated abusive language detection, the development of high-quality linguistic resources, and the design of **socially responsible AI systems**. I bring together computational approaches and critical perspectives on language and harm to create tools that are ethically informed. I'm driven by a commitment to **fair and equitable machine learning** that is aware of its social implications and helps build **safer, more inclusive digital spaces**.

[Learn more about me &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}

:::
